title: Schemas plus policy.json are the canonical control-plane contract
problem: Rules must live in one machine-checked place; prose, prompts and memory files drift.

options.summary: JSON Schemas (docs/engineering-operations/workforce/schemas) define object shape; policy.json defines state machines, command authorization, SYSTEM allowlist, human approval, reservation compatibility, lease TTLs, scheduler/backpressure/anti-thrash parameters, merge lanes and evidence trust

rationale: The engine loads and validates policy.json (fail closed) and pins its digest on every event. Operational state (heartbeats, leases, store) lives outside git under .arena/workforce-state/ (gitignored). Manager memory files are derived views regenerated by the CLI. GitHub main remains the single code authority; no second authority is created.
